title: Wrap long rows in foam list so the columns stay aligned
body: When a row's trailing text (title, blockers, rollup) is longer than the terminal is wide, the terminal wraps it at whatever column it reaches, and the id, priority and status columns of the rows below no longer line up with the ones above. Wrap the trailing text at the terminal width and indent each continuation line under the start of the title, so a long row reads as one entry and the columns hold. --plain already promises no wrapping, so leave it alone.
close_reason: titles wrap under their column in the terminal form; unit test in render.rs

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6de6737a
notes.text: Done: the terminal form wraps the title with wrap_at at width minus the column prefix (floor 20), hangs later lines under the title column, and keeps the dim tags and suffix on the title's last line when they fit, else on a line of their own. Plain output untouched.
